description: This file is a shell script designed for initializing and managing network interfaces and virtual LANs in a network device. It includes functions for starting and stopping network segments, configuring interfaces, managing bridge interfaces, and handling event-driven state changes related to Layer 2 networking. The script interacts with system events, interface functions, and external scripts to set up or tear down network configurations.

methods.name: start_net
methods.description: Starts a network segment given a network ID, sets its status to starting, loads network configuration, and sets up interfaces and bridge as needed.

methods.name: stop_net
methods.description: Stops a network segment given its network ID, updates status, removes interfaces, and tears down bridges.

methods.name: load_net
methods.description: Loads network configuration parameters such as name, VID, and members from persistent storage for a given network ID.

methods.name: config_new_members
methods.description: Configures and brings up the interfaces, VLANs, and bridges for a network, based on its members and types.

methods.name: del_old_members
methods.description: Removes old or deprecated interface members from a network configuration, including cleanup of sys events and interface configurations.

methods.name: update_net_status
methods.description: Updates the network's status based on its current members and readiness, signaling partial, none, or full readiness.

methods.name: handle_member_status_update
methods.description: Handles updates of individual member interface statuses, updating network membership and state accordingly.

methods.name: configure_members
methods.description: Configures or disables a list of member interfaces for a network, including VLAN setup and registration.

methods.name: configure_if
methods.description: Configures individual interfaces for VLAN tagging, adding or removing interfaces from bridges.

methods.name: sync_members
methods.description: Synchronizes the list of members for a network, removing unused members and adding new ones.

methods.name: sync_networks
methods.description: Synchronizes the active network instances with persistent storage, starting or stopping networks as needed.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts all network instances as configured in persistent storage.
